meta.sidedness: two-sided for every t and z test; F and chi-square tests are omnibus
meta.group_results_seen_before_freeze: Group results for related quantities existed and had been seen before this freeze: Stage 03 (Movement by CC x phase), Stage 09 (Movement_mean/Movement_rmssd/Entropy_acf1 vs CombZ at 10 and 5 min), Stage 14 (first-night five-domain lm, HMM heatmap incl. CC-averaged Group:Sex), Stages 20-25 (GAMM, incl. light-phase SIS-CON contrasts), Stage 28 (four-domain composites at 10 and 5 min).

population.rfid_cohort: 111 RFID-tracked animals (of 117 with CombZ); 6 B1 males never tracked (0001, 0002, OQ750-OQ753)

primary.definition: animals not on Analysis/con_animals.csv (outcome_group RES or SUS)
primary.rationale: the RES/SUS question is within SIS; the CON cage structure must not drive the primary random effects

exposure.definition: all 111 RFID animals; CON vs SIS

population.exclusions_upstream: raw_data/excluded_animals.csv applied by preprocessing (reasons undocumented); no QC-based exclusion
population.baseline: none: no RFID recording exists before CC1 (P25) in any batch; earlier MMM files are hardware/naming tests or duplicate exports; initScan files are post-change scans (verified 2026-09-27, PREFREEZE_CHECKS item D)
population.open_interpretive_question: whether the CC1 grouping was procedurally identical for CON and SIS (affects wording only, not design)

sex_batch.rule: Sex is determined by Batch; no Sex main effect is estimated alongside Batch

primary.definition: first full active phase after each cage change: [anchor, anchor + 43,200 s) on the RFID logger clock
primary.anchor: 18:30:00 (logger clock, tz UTC) on the calendar day of each SourceFile's first timestamp t0; stop unless 0 <= t0 - anchor < 3600 s; must equal the Stage 28 provenance anchor for 24/24 SourceFiles (runtime gate)
primary.lag_note: starts an estimated 2.3-8.5 h after the physical cage change (lower bound from RFID recording start)

light_phase.definition: [anchor + 43,200 s, anchor + 86,400 s) following the primary active phase of the same cage change
light_phase.coverage_rule: each SourceFile's last timestamp must be >= anchor + 86,400 s, otherwise its light-phase windows are NA and counted in G tables
light_phase.role: secondary readout: exposure (CON vs SIS) and within-SIS estimates only; label 'light-phase activity', never 'sleep'
light_phase.disclosure: added after existing Stage 23/25 SIS-vs-CON light-phase results had been seen

cumulative.definition: [anchor, anchor + h) of the first active phase after CC1, observed-hours denominator; CC1 only
cumulative.report: KR estimate + 95% CI, no p; standardised by the 12-h standardizer_sd
cumulative.name: first h hours of the active phase after CC1 (never 'acute' or 'early response')
cumulative.role: estimation-only temporal localisation; never replaces the full 12-h window

windows.not_analysed: the post-change afternoon (removed by preprocessing) is not part of this analysis

event_stream.seed: per animal x file, the last on-grid raw read before the file's first timestamp t0, recovered from raw_data (Stage 01 rule) and stamped at t0; the raw-label parser strips both '_sys.' and '-sys.' suffixes
event_stream.seed_parser_fix: Stage 01 (Analysis/01_build_multiscale_behavior_metrics.R:605) strips only '_sys.'; the canonical stream fixes this (8 B1 CC2 animals gain a seed)
event_stream.stage01_not_rebuilt: Stage 01 bin tables are NOT rebuilt; they keep the seed bug for 8 B1 CC2 animals (slot 1 only). They are used only for the CC1 lag block (unaffected) and by the registered Stage 09 (CC1 only, unaffected).
event_stream.carry_forward: an animal occupies the PositionID of its last read (or seed) until its next read; after its last read in the file, until the window end; observation starts at t0 (seeded animals) or at the first read (unseeded); a seed is never back-filled before t0
event_stream.event: a change of PositionID between consecutive reads of the same animal within SourceFile x System

validation.pre_implementation: evidence/implementation_2026-09-27/impl_01: with the Stage 01 parser every metric equals the audit's group-blind caches (max |d| = 0); with the fixed parser only these differ: all metrics for 3, 4, OQ754, OQ755, OQ762, OQ764, OQ772, OQ773 at CC2 (re-seeded) and shared_zone_use for OQ770, OQ771 at CC2 (their cage-mates)
runtime_gates: event counts per active window equal the Stage 01 10-min Movement sums, except the 8 re-seeded B1 CC2 windows
anchors equal the Stage 28 provenance target_window_start for 24/24 SourceFiles

crossing_rate.label: antenna-crossing rate
crossing_rate.definition: number of events in the window / observed hours (sum of occupancy-run durations within the window)
crossing_rate.disclosure: numerically equivalent to 6 x Movement_mean (<= 0.21% at CC1), whose group results had been seen (Stages 03, 09, 14, 28)

shared_zone_use.label: shared antenna-zone use
shared_zone_use.interpretation: relational/social-spatial overlap in antenna-zone use with current tracked cage-mates
shared_zone_use.definition: sum over tracked cage-mates of seconds both animals are assigned to the same PositionID / sum over tracked cage-mates of seconds both are observed, within the window; NA without a tracked cage-mate
shared_zone_use.caveat: about 95% of between-animal variance is reproduced by chance overlap of hour-by-hour zone occupancy
shared_zone_use.disclosure: time-weighted analogue of Proximity_mean, whose group results had been seen (Stages 14, 28)

occupancy_dispersion.label: occupancy dispersion
occupancy_dispersion.definition: Shannon entropy (log2; 0 log 0 = 0) of the share of window occupancy time assigned to each of the 8 PositionIDs
occupancy_dispersion.disclosure: defined after related group results had been seen

fragmentation.label: fragmentation
fragmentation.definition: share of activity bouts that contain exactly one crossing
fragmentation.bout_criterion_rule: intersection of the weighted components of a 2-component normal mixture on pooled log10 inter-event intervals (all 444 active windows, both sexes; mclust model 'V'); rule declared before fitting; value frozen as this constant (computed on the Stage 01-parser stream) and never re-estimated
fragmentation.bout_rule: a new bout starts at the first event of the window and at every event whose gap to the previous event is > criterion
fragmentation.disclosure: defined after related group results had been seen

light_phase_crossing_rate.label: light-phase activity
light_phase_crossing_rate.definition: as crossing_rate, in the light-phase window
light_phase_crossing_rate.animal_term: (1 | AnimalID) in longitudinal models (the cc1 slope evidence is active-phase only)
light_phase_crossing_rate.legacy: Stage 23/25 light-phase GAMM/Markov results are legacy support only (no cage term; 3 CON cages per sex); they feed no product

descriptive.events_per_bout: mean crossings per bout at the bout criterion
descriptive.bout_decomposition: crossing rate = bouts/hour x events/bout, at criteria 19.6985494137682, 39.3970988275363, 78.7941976550726, 149.84699971049 (2-process log-survivorship) and 1341.67100391129 s (3-process long-rest boundary), all from evidence/design_phase_A2/bout-occupancy-study/02_bout_criteria.csv

lag_block.estimator: adjacency-aware RMSSD/ACF1 (pairs of consecutive slots only; Functions/first_night_domain_helpers.R) on Stage 01 bins, as in Stage 28
lag_block.scope: CC1 only (Stage 01 CC1 bins are unaffected by the seed bug)
lag_block.models: CC1_POOLED and CC1_BY_SEX formulas; estimands Q1, RS_sexavg_CC1, RS_by_sex_CC1; KR estimate + 95% CI; no p
lag_block.disclosure: resolutions are disclosed judgements; Proximity 5 min is a post-hoc change from Stage 28's single 10-min setting; group results at 5 and 10 min had been seen (Stages 14, 28)

retired: Entropy_acf1 (kept only inside the Stage 09 registry)
Stage 28 composites (kept as frozen legacy output)

exploratory.hmm: Stage 08/14 HMM state architecture at 10 min; no first-night HMM; not exported as a result

coding.Batch: factor, treatment coding; droplevels() inside every subset (strata, LOBO, S18, D4, complete case)
coding.CageChange: c2, c3, c4 treatment dummies (CC1 reference); categorical in every fixed part
coding.cc1: CC index - 1 (random-slope covariate for the active-phase crossing rate only; origin CC1)
coding.d1_d4: indicator of CC k (k = 1..4), used by D3 only
coding.conCage: 1 if the cage epoch is CON-only (exposure analysis)
coding.isCON: 1 for CON animals (persistent-CON-group term, exposure longitudinal)
coding.Session: Batch:CC (24 levels), used by S3 only
coding.CageEpisodeID: Batch|System|CC (physical cage in one cage-change epoch)
coding.units: raw units in every model; standardized = raw / standardizer_sd (supplementary)

fitting.df_method: Kenward-Roger for every lmer-based test and CI; other rows use the reference declared in their own entry
fitting.ci_method: estimate +/- qt(0.975, df_KR) x SE_KR from lmerTest::contest(ddf = 'Kenward-Roger', confint = TRUE); OLS rows: classical t
fitting.rank_rule: before fitting, X = model.matrix(nobars(formula), droplevels(data)) must have rank == ncol == expected_rank; lmer fitted with check.rankX = 'stop.deficient'; stop if getME(fit, 'X') has col.dropped; never wrap fits in suppressMessages/suppressWarnings; capture and store every message
fitting.singular_rule: the frozen random structure of every model, including (1 + cc1 || AnimalID), conCage/sisCage and (0 + isCON | Batch), is kept in every pooled, stratified, LOBO and sensitivity fit even when singular; singularity is logged
fitting.optimizer_check: refit from the stored formula and data with lme4's five built-in allFit optimizers (bobyqa, Nelder_Mead, nlminbwrap, nloptwrap NLOPT_LN_NELDERMEAD and NLOPT_LN_BOBYQA; mmm_ci_optimizer_check, because lme4::allFit's update() cannot re-evaluate these calls); run for the crossing-rate slope models TR_POOLED and TR_BY_SEX (F, M) always, and for every lmer fit with a convergence warning; agreement = among optimizers without a convergence warning, logLik range < 1e-6 and, for every fixed effect, range across optimizers < 0.01 x its bobyqa SE; the relative difference range / |mean| is reported only (ill-conditioned near 0: replaced before the freeze after the permuted-label dry run, evidence/implementation_2026-09-27/dryrun)
fitting.failure_rule: a fit fails if it errors, or if a convergence warning persists and allFit optimizers disagree (optimizer_check); if converging optimizers agree, the bobyqa fit is used and the warning logged; a failed row is reported FAILED with no estimate or p, the family keeps its declared m, and any respecification requires a new config_version
no_terms: random slopes except the active-phase crossing rate

CC1_POOLED.notes: one row per animal; NO Animal random effect

CC1_BY_SEX.role: localisation / estimation; never a formal test of sex difference
CC1_BY_SEX.run_rule: fitted and reported for all four constructs regardless of the pooled result; never conditional on significance

TR_POOLED.formula: y ~ Batch + g_RS + c2 + c3 + c4 + g_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4) + g_RS:sex_c + (c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c + g_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c + (1 | AnimalID) + (1 | CageEpisodeID)
TR_POOLED.formula_crossing_rate: y ~ Batch + g_RS + c2 + c3 + c4 + g_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4) + g_RS:sex_c + (c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c + g_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c + (1 + cc1 || AnimalID) + (1 | CageEpisodeID)

random_slope.evidence: group-blind SIS nuisance fits: uncorrelated slope vs intercept-only LR 21.7, dBIC -15.8 (F -7.1, M -3.2); covariance not supported (dBIC +5.7, F +5.2, M +3.6); centring at CC 2.5 rejected (implies U-shaped variance)

TR_BY_SEX.formula: y ~ Batch + g_RS + c2 + c3 + c4 + g_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4) + (1 | AnimalID) + (1 | CageEpisodeID)
TR_BY_SEX.formula_crossing_rate: y ~ Batch + g_RS + c2 + c3 + c4 + g_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4) + (1 + cc1 || AnimalID) + (1 | CageEpisodeID)
TR_BY_SEX.run_rule: fitted and reported for all four constructs regardless of the pooled result; never conditional on significance

EXPOSURE_CC1.formula: y ~ Batch + g_SIS + g_SIS:sex_c + (0 + conCage | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + sisCage | CageEpisodeID)
EXPOSURE_CC1.formula_by_sex: y ~ Batch + g_SIS + (0 + conCage | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + sisCage | CageEpisodeID)
EXPOSURE_CC1.caveat: CON is cage-segregated: 3 CON cages per sex; SIS-CON is a between-cage contrast

EXPOSURE_TR.formula: y ~ Batch + g_SIS + c2 + c3 + c4 + g_SIS:(c2 + c3 + c4) + g_SIS:sex_c + (c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c + g_SIS:(c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c + (1 | AnimalID) + (0 + conCage | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + sisCage | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + isCON | Batch)
EXPOSURE_TR.formula_by_sex: y ~ Batch + g_SIS + c2 + c3 + c4 + g_SIS:(c2 + c3 + c4) + (1 | AnimalID) + (0 + conCage | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + sisCage | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + isCON | Batch)

CONTINUOUS.engine: OLS (classical t, n - 8 df); robustness: clubSandwich CR2 by CC1 CageEpisodeID with Satterthwaite df
CONTINUOUS.report: estimate + 95% CI; CR2 SE as robustness; no p
CONTINUOUS.relation: not independent of the RES/SUS characterisation or of Stage 09 (same animals, same CombZ)

Q2b.meaning: does the RES/SUS trajectory across cage changes differ by sex

Q2b_components.meaning: each g_RS:ck:sex_c (change of DiD from CC1 to CCk)

Q2c.role: secondary estimand; estimate + 95% CI; no p

Q2a.meaning: sex-averaged RES/SUS change from CC1 to CCk
Q2a.role: secondary estimand; estimate + 95% CI per component; no joint test, no p

RS_sexavg_CC1.role: secondary estimand; estimate + 95% CI; no p

RS_sexavg_by_CC.meaning: sex-averaged RES-SUS at CC1 = g_RS; at CCk = g_RS + g_RS:ck

RS_by_sex_CC1.role: follow-up / localisation; p with Holm over the 2 sexes (FU-CC1)

RS_by_sex_by_CC.meaning: RES-SUS at CC1 = g_RS; at CCk = g_RS + g_RS:ck

TR_by_sex.role: follow-up / localisation; p with Holm over the 2 sexes (FU-TR)

group_means.L: (Intercept) + equal-weight mean of the within-sex Batch effects (+ ck) +/- 1/2 g_RS (+/- 1/2 g_RS:ck)
group_means.role: estimate + 95% CI for Figure 1c/d; per-sex means and SEs come only from stratified fits

Sex_by_CC.role: estimate + 95% CI only (nuisance batch-set x CC)

contrasts.CON_contrasts_policy: RES-CON and SUS-CON are not tested; CON appears descriptively and in the exposure analysis

multiplicity.applied_once_in: Analysis/29_canonical_behavior_characterization.R (P-*, S-*, FU-* families) and Analysis/09_early_prediction_model_ladder.R (PR1, PR3 as registered; PR2 Holm applied by the bundle writer); Analysis/16b recomputes and verifies every p_adjusted

PR1.note: Stage 09 internal registry continuity; not a preregistration

sensitivities.p_value_policy: HETEROSCEDASTIC A/B and SHARED_ZONE D1 rows report p_raw plus a boolean decision indicator (Holm recomputed as defined in their rules; not an exported q-value). Stage 09 sensitivity rows report their own statistic and p_raw without adjustment. All other sensitivity rows (LOBO, D2, D3, D4, complete case, S2-S18) report estimate, SE, 95% CI and a robustness label only, with no p.

LOBO.applies: Q1, Q2b components, RS_by_sex_CC1; all four constructs
LOBO.rule: pooled estimands (Q1, Q2b components): 'robust to single-batch removal' only if the sign is stable in 6/6 refits; within-sex RS_by_sex_CC1: 3/3 same-sex refits; otherwise name the leverage batch

HETEROSCEDASTIC.A: difference of the sex-stratified estimates, all variance components sex-specific; SEs and covariances are KR-adjusted (pbkrtest::vcovAdj): Q1 d = RS_F - RS_M, SE = sqrt(se_F^2 + se_M^2); Q2b 3-df Wald on b_F - b_M of g_RS:ck with V_F + V_M
HETEROSCEDASTIC.A_reference: Q1: t with nu = (se_F^2 + se_M^2)^2 / (se_F^4/nu_F + se_M^4/nu_M), nu_s = the CC1_BY_SEX KR df of g_RS; Q2b: F = W/3 ~ F(3, nu), nu = min of the two TR_by_sex joint-F KR denominator df
HETEROSCEDASTIC.B: glmmTMB(REML = TRUE, dispformula = ~ sex_c) with the primary fixed and random parts (crossing-rate longitudinal animal term diag(1 + cc1 | AnimalID)); Q1 Wald z; Q2b Wald chi-square(3); Q2b components Wald z

material_dependence.holm: Holm (m = 2) recomputed with BOTH family members' p-values from the same comparator gives a different decision for this member
material_dependence.ci_Q1: whether the 95% CI of Q1 excludes 0 differs
material_dependence.p_Q2b: whether the unadjusted 3-df Q2b p < alpha differs
material_dependence.shift: Q1 and each Q2b component: |comparator - primary| >= 0.5 primary SE, or signs differ with both |estimates| >= 0.5 primary SE; for Q2b material if any component meets it

HETEROSCEDASTIC.if_material: report both; state that inference is variance-model-sensitive; do not privilege the homoscedastic result
HETEROSCEDASTIC.shared_zone_use_note: A and B are run for shared zone use as for all constructs; the primary stays homoscedastic unless diagnostics$zone_variance indicates otherwise

SHARED_ZONE.primary: animal-level cage-aware models (CC1_POOLED, TR_POOLED) with the Holm-adjusted primary result

D1.cc1: clubSandwich::vcovCR(as(CC1_POOLED lmer fit, 'lmerMod'), cluster = CageEpisodeID, type = 'CR2'); Q1 via coef_test(test = 'Satterthwaite'); 22 clusters (F 12, M 10)
D1.longitudinal: lm(fixed part of TR_POOLED) on the 345 shared-zone rows; sandwich::vcovCL(cluster = ~ AnimalID + CageEpisodeID, type = 'HC3', cadjust = TRUE, multi0 = FALSE); negative eigenvalues of V set to 0; W = b'V^-1 b over g_RS:ck:sex_c, F = W/3 ~ F(3, G - 1), G = min(n animals, n cage epochs)
D1.calibration: within-Batch permutation null on permuted labels only, before the freeze (evidence/implementation_2026-09-27/ d2_calibration/RESULTS.txt): rejection at nominal 5% was CC1 CR2 0.035; longitudinal HC1 0.093-0.115, HC2 0.067, HC3 0.030; HC1 was therefore replaced by HC3. The primary KR tests rejected 0.035-0.065.
D1.support_rule: Q1: replace the zone member's primary p with the D1 p in P-CC1 (partner unchanged); D1 supports the effect if the zone member is rejected at alpha AND the D1 estimate has the primary sign. Q2b: D1 supports if the recomputed P-TR Holm rejects the zone member at alpha.
D1.strong_wording_rule: strong inferential wording requires the primary Holm result AND D1 to support the effect

D2.model_cc1: lm(frac ~ 0 + factor(CageEpisodeID) + s_RS + s_RS:sex_c); SIS dyads with both members tracked; unweighted; rank 24 (22 cages)
D2.model_tr: lm(frac ~ 0 + factor(CageEpisodeID) + s_RS + s_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4) + s_RS:sex_c + s_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c); rank 101
D2.s_RS: RES-ness(A) + RES-ness(B), RES = +1/2, SUS = -1/2; mixed dyads (s_RS = 0) are used
D2.se: clubSandwich CR2 by CageEpisodeID with Satterthwaite df (single coefficients) and the HTZ Wald F for the Q2b analogue. Replaced, before the freeze, the dyad-robust (shared-animal) sandwich, which rejected 18-21% (CC1) and 14-17% (CC1-CC4) of within-Batch permutation-null draws at nominal 5% and was not always positive definite; CR2 by cage epoch rejected 5.8-7.5% (CC1) and 4.3-6.7% (CC1-CC4). Null calibration on permuted labels only: evidence/implementation_2026-09-27/d2_calibration/RESULTS.txt
D2.reported: RR_vs_SS = 2 x s_RS and DiD_RR_vs_SS = 2 x (s_RS:sex_c) at CC1; 2 x s_RS:ck:sex_c components longitudinally (additivity)
D2.magnitude_scale: implied animal-level value = beta x mean over analysed animals of (n_i - 2)/(n_i - 1), n_i = tracked animals in the cage

assessment.same_direction: implied value has the primary estimate's sign (Q1 at CC1; each Q2b component)
assessment.broadly_compatible: implied value inside the primary 95% CI, or implied/primary ratio in [0.5, 2]
assessment.clear_contradiction: the D2 95% CI excludes 0 with the sign opposite to the primary estimate

D2.not_required: D2 need not have a CI excluding 0

D3.formula_random: TR_POOLED with (1 | CageEpisodeID) replaced by (0 + d1 | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + d2 | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + d3 | CageEpisodeID) + (0 + d4 | CageEpisodeID)

variants: CC1_POOLED/TR_POOLED on rows in cage epochs with 4 tracked animals (rank 8/20)
CC1_POOLED/TR_POOLED + factor(n_tracked_mates) in the fixed part (rank 9/22)

complete_case.definition: drop OQ755, OQ770, OQ771 (the 3 animals with a missing window) at every CC

SHARED_ZONE.downgrade_rule: a sensitivity labelled SIGN_CHANGE, or a D2 clear_contradiction, is reported explicitly and downgrades the interpretation

OTHER.S2_batch_x_cc: y ~ Batch*(c2 + c3 + c4) + g_RS*(c2 + c3 + c4) + g_RS:sex_c + g_RS:(c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c + <frozen random part>; rank 32
OTHER.S3_session_re: TR_POOLED + (1 | Session); source of the Sex_by_CC estimates
OTHER.S7_crossing_ri_only: crossing rate TR_POOLED with (1 | AnimalID) only
OTHER.S7b_crossing_correlated_slope: crossing rate TR_POOLED with (1 + cc1 | AnimalID)
OTHER.S12_reversal_filtered: A->B->A excursions shorter than 20 s merged into their neighbours (greedy, non-overlapping); all four constructs
OTHER.S13_hardware: exclude exactly the 6 animal-windows in dead/near-dead-antenna cage epochs: 314, 318, OR620, OR630 (B5|sys.1|CC4) and OR112, OR141 (B2|sys.2|CC3); occupancy_dispersion and shared_zone_use; animal 692 B6 CC1 (7/8 positions through low activity) is retained; cage-mates' values are not recomputed
OTHER.S18_B1_excluded: shared zone use without B1 (70% tracked)

labels_in_order.SIGN_CHANGE: signs differ and both |estimates| >= 0.5 primary SE

robustness_label_rule.precedence: evaluated in order SIGN_CHANGE, LARGE_SHIFT, COMPATIBLE; first match wins
robustness_label_rule.scope: S2, S3, S7, S7b, S11, S12, S13, S18, D3, D4, complete case; for Q2b per component g_RS:ck:sex_c; not D1, D2, LOBO, HETEROSCEDASTIC, cumulative, lag
robustness_label_rule.note: labels never change the primary result

zone_variance.definition: group-blind SIS nuisance fits (Group not read): y ~ Batch (CC1) and y ~ Batch + c2 + c3 + c4 + (c2 + c3 + c4):sex_c (CC1-CC4) with the frozen random part, glmmTMB ML with vs without dispformula = ~ Sex
zone_variance.trigger: indicates otherwise iff boundary-free LR p < 0.05 AND dBIC < 0 in either analysis; then comparator B is reported as co-primary for shared zone use
zone_variance.pre_freeze_result: CC1 LR 1.42 (dBIC +3.0), CC1-CC4 LR 3.22 (dBIC +2.6): NOT indicated (evidence/revision_2026-09-27/rev_02)

reported_only: drop-one-cage influence on Q1 (range of estimates)
within-sex batch homogeneity of RES-SUS (Batch x g_RS within sex; CC1)
residual SD by Sex x Group
diagnostics.role: reported; never a stop and never a reason to respecify, except zone_variance

stage09.role: prediction view; internal analysis-registry entry (docs/MANUSCRIPT_ANALYSIS_REGISTRY.csv), unchanged; not a preregistration
stage09.history_disclosure: Stage 09 was created at 5-min bins (commit 946efa6, 2026-05-13; declared primary in ae44a78, 2026-05-17) and switched to 10 min on 2026-05-20 (8e29932) without a recorded rationale; 10 min is retained for registry continuity and is NOT presented as prospectively selected.

sensitivities.resolution_5min: Stage 09 rerun with MMM_STAGE09_BIN_LEVEL = 5min_based on canonical CombZ
sensitivities.cv: LOAO R2 (full-sample mean denominator, as Stage 09) with folds = CC1 CageEpisodeID (leave-one-cage-out) and = Batch (leave-one-batch-out)
sensitivities.permutation: CombZ permuted within Batch; B = 1000; full LOAO refit per permutation; p = (#null >= observed + 1)/(B + 1)
sensitivities.batch_adjusted_sex: CombZ ~ Batch + x + x:sex_c for the 3 registered features (OLS)

stage09.removed_from_inferential_story: pooled-sex descriptive Wilcoxon group tests (not exported)
stage09.resolution_choice_rule: 5 vs 10 min is never chosen by which gives the stronger result

primary_fields: shared_zone D1 (d1_supports, strong_wording_allowed), D2 assessment, D3, D4, complete case
reporting.q2b_rule: Q2b rows carry n_animals, n_batches, n_cage_episodes + q2b_fields; estimate/se/ci/standardized are given per component and per DiD_by_CC
q2b_fields: RES-SUS by CC by sex with CI
reporting.null_wording: a non-significant sex-moderation result means imprecise data, not equivalence; always show estimate, CI and adjusted p
reporting.within_sex_wording: 'the estimated RES-SUS difference was larger in X, but the formal sex-moderation estimate was imprecise' when the pooled CI crosses 0
causal_wording: animals later classified RES/SUS differed during the first active phase after CC1
early behavioural differences associated with later resilience/susceptibility
prohibited_causal_wording: female-specific (unless the pooled interaction supports it)

panels.c: CC1 primary characterisation: crossing rate, shared zone use; per-sex RES/SUS model estimates; sex-difference contrast; P-CC1 Holm p
panels.d: CC1-CC4 trajectories: crossing rate, shared zone use; sex-stratified; Q2b P-TR Holm p
panels.e: early crossing rate vs later CombZ (refreshed Stage 09)

c.points: A1 animal values by group within sex; CON in grey, descriptive (no model)
c.did: Q1 with the P-CC1 Holm p

d.con: CON per-CC means in grey, descriptive
d.test: Q2b with the P-TR Holm p
d.legend: Q2c is reported as a secondary estimate

e.statistic: PR1 Spearman rho with bootstrap CI and BH q

f.statistic: Stage 09 LOAO R2, repeated-CV mean and quantiles, permutation null (PR2 Holm p)
